description: This PHP source file defines a class 'ADODB2_db2' that extends 'ADODB_DataDict' to implement database schema operations specifically for IBM DB2. It includes methods for type conversion, altering columns, dropping columns, and changing tables, tailored to DB2 syntax and constraints.

classes.name: ADODB2_db2
classes.description: A schema management class for IBM DB2 databases, providing methods for altering, dropping, and modifying table schemas.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Converts meta type codes to DB2-compatible data types.

methods.name: _CreateSuffix
methods.description: Builds SQL suffix for column definitions, including defaults, nullability, and auto-increment.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL statements to alter columns, not supported for DB2 in this implementation.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL statements to drop columns, not supported for DB2.

methods.name: ChangeTableSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to change table structure, handling character and non-character columns, with limited support for altering existing columns.
